purpose: Converts positions, oriented boxes, and radii into axis-aligned Roblox `Region3` values.
description: Provides stateless constructors for common `Region3` bounds.

Region3Utils.luau.description: Builds axis-aligned regions from a position and size, an oriented box, or a radius. Public entry points include `Region3Utils.fromPositionSize`, `Region3Utils.fromBox`, `Region3Utils.fromRadius`.
